text:
IMOGEN:
  You should have kept watching him until he was as small as a crow, or smaller.
  Only then should you have stopped looking after him.
PISANIO:
  Madam, I did.
IMOGEN:
  I would have strained my eyes until they broke, just to keep looking at him.
  I'd have watched until the distance shrank him to a point, sharp as my needle.
  No, I'd have followed him until he melted away, from the size of a gnat into thin air.
  And then I'd have turned away and cried.
  But, good Pisanio, when will we hear from him?
